purpose: Make the remedy layer executable: each route has a default move, blocked move, escalation trigger, guardrails, and proceeds-integrity posture.

remedy_families.channel_access_and_cure: Preserve public or assisted access, notice, cure, no-rent timing, and hardship escalation when a channel controls the tax claim.
remedy_families.record_correction_and_accountable_review: Correct official, third-party, model, or vendor records through review authority and issue-scoped finality.
remedy_families.floor_repair_and_no_rent_relief: Protect subsistence, disability, housing, health, family, care, connectivity, or other floors before extracting revenue.
remedy_families.rent_capture_with_pass_through_control: Reach residual rents upstream while stopping workers, tenants, consumers, suppliers, or small vendors from bearing the rent tax.
remedy_families.harm_repair_or_no_go: Use repair, mitigation, exposure reduction, bond, reserve, permit denial, or no-go treatment for harms that cannot be priced safely.
remedy_families.risk_prefunding_and_clawback: Prefund backstops, price correlated risk, and claw back private upside when public insurance or guarantees are used.
remedy_families.public_upside_and_anti_supplantation: Condition subsidy/procurement/public-input value, retain public upside, and prevent repair money from replacing baseline duties.
remedy_families.classification_correction: Route by real control, benefit, burden, or duty rather than the paper label.
remedy_families.source_release_integrity: Block release, refresh sources, regenerate machine surfaces, or retire routes when integrity checks fail.
remedy_families.general_design_review: Keep broad tax-design issues in explicit design review until a concrete remedy path is chosen.

policy: A route is not remedy-complete merely because its remedy_type axis is non-empty. It must have an auditable profile tied to incidence, channel, escalation, and proceeds integrity.
